prompt:
Create ONE new high-detail portrait-format 2:3 friendship poster. The PRIMARY CHANGE requested by the user is a much wider range of BRETT'S ACTUAL LOOKS AND EXPRESSIONS, grounded in his different reference photographs. Avoid repeating a neutral smirk, the same olive overshirt, same face angle, same table composition or same brown-and-gold palette across these new works.

IDENTITY MAPPING: References1 and2 are Sean (same person); reference3 is the PRIMARY LOOK reference for Brett for this specific poster; any subsequent references are further photos of the SAME Brett. Exactly TWO real adult men in the final scene: Sean and Brett. Use strong faithful likeness to their actual facial structures, noses, lips, eye spacing, cheek and jaw shapes; never merge the men, make generic models or replace Brett's face with Sean's. Sean's dark swept-up hair and light stubble remain identifiable. Brett's hair length/style, glasses, beanie, visible light facial stubble and clothing must follow THIS poster's primary look reference rather than the earliest shirtless photo. All Brett photographs show the same adult across different looks. Preserve his real physique; don't add tattoos or unrealistic bodybuilding. When Sean's tattoo is visible, it belongs ONLY to Sean and is based on reference2; mirror orientation may differ in reference selfie. Photos are identity inputs, not final pose/background. Exclude all source camera stamps, phone watermarks, filters, background bystanders and unrelated photo content. Preserve natural skin where realistic, no beauty filter.

EXPRESSION DIRECTION: The specified expression must be unmistakable and different from the other posters yet anatomically natural and recognizable: believable eyes, brows, cheek muscles and mouth, no distorted teeth or grotesque open mouths. Sean should have an appropriate distinct reaction and equal human dignity. Stage imaginative brotherhood scenes, never claim they are historical photographs or real message screenshots. Their dynamic is affectionate and reciprocal, with irreverent humor, gaming, writing/theater/music and ambitious ideas, occasional frustration and repair. No fixed helpless/rescuer roles. Typography exact, legible, cleanly spaced with safe margins, strong poster design and dominant expressive portraits. No slurs, explicit sex, sexual violence, actual self-harm, invented tragedies or memorial symbolism. Unless specified no more readable text than title and footer.

An emotionally warm, carefully painted watercolor-and-gouache portrait poster, pale sage, dusty rose, ivory and soft morning sky. Brett right wears a plain tan hoodie, short natural curls and slightly wispy fringe following reference3; his face carries an unmistakable relieved exhale, softened eyes and a small sincere smile, shoulders dropping. Sean left offers an equally relaxed smile, seated beside Brett on a modest kitchen bench, both holding ordinary mugs after a conversation. No consoling hierarchy or forced tears. Hands natural, expressive faces dominate, gentle translucent brushwork and beautiful negative space, fresh airy palette rather than amber theater decor. Exact title "ALL GOOD, MAN"; small footer "WE CAN START AGAIN." No other readable text, no copied cartoon branding from reference hoodie.

qa.composition: Fresh sage/dusty rose/ivory watercolor-gouache palette, modest kitchen with two ordinary mugs, equal height and dignity; natural hands.

qa.limitations: Sean's incidental Columbia clothing print and small apparel emblem remain; main expressive variation and likeness goals preserved. Imagined friendship scene, not a verified event.
